definitions.explanation: The act of sticking or affixing something (a stamp, sticker, label, patch, etc.) onto a surface. A formal word commonly used in official and administrative contexts.

examples.japanese: {収入印紙|しゅうにゅういんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貼付|ちょうふ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{所定|しょてい}→所定：12938_shotei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{貼付|ちょうふ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please affix a photo in the designated area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{申請書|しんせいしょ}→申請書：07486_shinseisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切手|きって}→切手：00718_kitte⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貼付|ちょうふ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: Affix a stamp to the application form and submit it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{湿布|しっぷ}→湿布：15751_shippu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{患部|かんぶ}→患部：18653_kanbu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{貼付|ちょうふ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I applied a compress to the affected area.

notes:
A formal word for sticking or affixing. The standard reading is ちょうふ, though てんぷ is also widely used (originally considered non-standard but now accepted). Very common on official forms, in medical contexts (applying patches/compresses), and in administrative instructions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {収入印紙|しゅうにゅういんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貼付|ちょうふ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to affix a revenue stamp
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧{貼付|ちょうふ}⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧: photo attachment area
- {貼付|ちょうふ}⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧: adhesive patch (medical)
- {貼付|ちょうふ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to affix; to paste on

PRONUNCIATION:
The reading てんぷ is also common and accepted, though ちょうふ is the traditional standard. In everyday conversation, ⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧ (to stick, paste) is used instead.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧: to stick; to paste — the everyday verb for the same action
- ⟦{添付|てんぷ}→添付：07376_tenpu⟧: attachment (especially of files) — attaching a document or file, not physically sticking something on
- {接着|せっちゃく}: adhesion; bonding — emphasizes the bonding between two surfaces
